title: Head-piece (trait) loader: per-facing load, give-up, later rounds, own-head watch
oneLine: Per head piece and facing: asking, loaded, designed-missing, gave-up, later rounds, plus a watch that re-asks hidden pieces.
topConcern: Watch starts a new three-try chain every 2.5 s beside one sleeping on its retry timer; rounds uncapped, unlike the spec.

title: Body placement data (body-anchors/body-tops): one promise, rounds after a failure
oneLine: Deduped fetch promise for the body placement tables, with retries and a 20 s re-arm after a failed round.
topConcern: Bare fetch without a timeout: a stalled request never settles, the promise is never re-armed, every head piece hidden for the page.

title: HUD bar art: load once, never asked again
oneLine: One-shot latch loading the HP/node bar frame and fill textures every bar draws from.
topConcern: A flaked bar-art load is swallowed and the latch never re-arms: monster, peer and node HP bars vanish until reload.

title: Masked-body bake worker and its one-job queue (rank, epoch, patience)
oneLine: Worker lifecycle plus a serial rank-ordered bake queue; local misses open epochs and fall back inline after 1 s.
topConcern: Only the local path has the hung-job patience; one job that never settles stalls peers, prewarm and look-armour bakes for the session.

title: Masked-body frame cache: LRU, worn-set-last eviction, deferred destroy
oneLine: Bounded LRU of armoured body frames; evicts other armour first; destroys evicted frames 30 s later.
topConcern: Worker-cropped frames are not canvas witnesses; other witnesses still catch a tab wipe.

title: Peer armoured frames: hold the last frame, prewarm on a look change
oneLine: Per peer display: hold the last masked frame while the worker bakes the next; queue their stand/jog prewarm.
topConcern: Hold has no deadline: a peer's belt-pending jog bake is never cached, so their body freezes on one frame until belt sheets load.

title: Armour prewarm passes: intro, idle one-equip-away, equip-change re-prewarm
oneLine: Debounce/running/again latch, supersede counter and owned-gear signature driving background armour bakes.
topConcern: A never-settling bake leaves _equipPrewarmRunning true forever; prewarmProgress is dead state nothing reads.

title: Fishing head-and-rod overlay cache (armoured or shirted angler)
oneLine: 64-entry LRU of per-frame canvas overlays lifting the head and rod above the shirt or plate while fishing.
topConcern: Eviction skips Pixi's Cache entry (TRAPS 139); three anglers thrash the per-frame keys, leaking ~64 KB per frame change.

title: A hat's hair-mask loader (per facing, ten later rounds)
oneLine: Per hat and facing: asking, loaded, failed, waiting, next round, up to ten rounds.
topConcern: Bare Assets.load without a time limit: a stalled mask is never retried, hair drawn unclipped through the hat all page.

title: NFT face and mannequin textures: loaded every session, never drawn
oneLine: One-shot latch loading test-1 NFT face sheets and naked stand sheets into slots nothing reads.
topConcern: Ten 256x256 pictures (2.5 MB decoded) held for the session by a dormant Bro-NFT phase-4 loader.

title: Module overrides set around a figure's head-piece placement
oneLine: _crownOverride, _folkHatDy256 and _qaHatDy256 change every _placeTrait while set around one figure's draw.
topConcern: _crownOverride has no try/finally: a throw mid-placement leaves the knight crown on later heads until reset.
linked: R2 peer and self trait placement

title: Hair clip target per figure (none, hat silhouette, hood)
oneLine: Per frame: clip the hair to a clipping hat's mask, else a ready hood mask, else unclipped.

title: Gathering node HP bar: ghost trail, flash, call halo
oneLine: One holder's ghost, drain and flash timers for the node bar; reset on hide, rebuilt on destroy.
topConcern: One holder for all nodes: switching nodes without a hidden frame flashes a phantom hit.

title: Chat bubble lifetime gate (plate steps aside)
oneLine: Per speaker a 5 s bubble window that hides the name plate while the bubble is drawn.
topConcern: The 5000 ms is written separately in entityRenderer, effectsRenderer and stateCleanup; unpinned.

title: Plate and head icons loaded once (Bro badge, small icons, quest pins)
oneLine: Held icon textures filled once on the loading screen and bound to plate and head sprites when present.
topConcern: No time limit or later round: a failed load leaves badge, party badge, skull and talk bubble invisible all session.

title: Threat skull phase over a head (red, white consent window)
oneLine: Pure time phase red then white then none over server-stamped threat times, with a per-display change cache.
topConcern: S._threatMarks is a plain {} keyed by wire ids (CLAUDE.md rule); ids are server-issued, so hygiene only.

title: Local corpse hold guard (selfCorpseUp, 3.5 s)
oneLine: Exported guard: dead while hp<=0 or within 3.5 s of _deathStart; stand-ins and gathering obey it.
topConcern: Self plate hides on S._dying, stand-ins on selfCorpseUp; consistent today, unpinned.

title: Carried greatsword grip hole (inverse stencil on the fist)
oneLine: One-bit _gripHoleOn latch on the weapon sprite with a clear that undoes mask side effects.

title: Attack stand-in clocks: swing 250/300 ms, bow draw-release-hold 110/360 ms
oneLine: Swing and bow-shot phases read off one start stamp against constants exported from this file.
topConcern: Arrow release latch hard-codes 110 in projectiles.js instead of BOW_RELEASE_MS; no mirror-audit line.

title: Overlay sprites made on first need (whirl glow, look-armour residue)
oneLine: Lazily created child sprites that copy the body while shown and blank themselves when their texture goes.
